_fields: pole/qualiGaps: grid-order classification (Qualifying + Hyperpole) and each car model's best lap over all qualifying segments, gap in s to pole. raceMedianTop5: median of top-5 class finishers' laps with green flag at the line, previous lap also green, no pit in/out, within 107% of the car's own green median. pitLaneTime: pit-lane transit from the drive-through cluster of PIT_TIME (pit entry to exit, no stop). pitTimeMedian: median PIT_TIME of normal stops (<180 s). stationary = pitTimeMedian - pitLaneTime; stationaryRefuelOnly / stationaryRefuelTyres: 2-means split of the stops that ended a near-full stint (>=70% of stintLaps; WEC: refuel and tyre change are sequential). stopLossTotal: median (in-lap + out-lap - 2 x car green median) for stops with green laps; pitLoss: per-stop median of (stop loss - (PIT_TIME - pitLaneTime)) = time lost to the pit lane alone, excluding stationary time. stintLaps: median laps between consecutive normal stops (>=5 laps). topSpeed: highest per-car best TOP_SPEED (speed trap) in the race, after discarding implausible trap readings >105% of the class median car-best (listed in topSpeedDiscarded); topSpeedMedianCarBest also given. lapLengthKm: derived from KPH x lap time. Notes: SC (SF flag) / FCY periods on the overall winner's lap numbers.
